description: Live power, today's hourly consumption from Home Assistant statistics, and what it costs.
aiSummary: Use when a whole-home power or energy sensor exists. Bind an electricity price sensor (e.g. Energi Data Service, Nord Pool) to `price` for hourly costs, or set the `tariff` prop for a flat price.

tariff.description: Flat price per kWh in the main currency unit. Used when no price sensor is bound.

surcharge.description: Added to every dynamic price per kWh, for grid tariffs and taxes the price sensor leaves out.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as DKK or EUR. Inferred from the price sensor's unit when omitted.
